rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for an elevated landform, even though it can also mean a mountain.

example.english: There’s a small hill near my home, and it isn’t too hard to walk up.
example.traditional: 我屋企附近有座小山，行上去唔算辛苦。
example.jyutping: ngo5 uk1 kei2 fu6 gan6 jau5 zo6 siu2 saan1 haang4 soeng5 heoi3 m4 syun3 san1 fu2

rows.note: Use this specifically for a road or street that slopes uphill or downhill.

example.english: This road up the hill gets very slippery on rainy days, so drive slowly.
example.traditional: 呢條斜路落雨天好跣，揸車要慢啲。
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 ce4 lou6 lok6 jyu5 tin1 hou2 sin3 zaa1 ce1 jiu3 maan6 di1
